meeting_scene: As the team files in, Vikram stands up, his usual confidence radiating from him, and begins to lead the meeting. "Good morning everyone, I wanted to touch base on the recent sales numbers, which are looking better than expected," he says, his voice smooth and assured. Priya nods in agreement, her morale still at an all-time high, and begins to brainstorm ideas for how to capitalize on this momentum. Meanwhile, Sam sits quietly, his stress levels simmering just below the surface, and Riya's eyes dart around the room, her stress levels evident in the tightness of her jaw. As the meeting wears on, the team's discussion becomes more animated, but Vikram's calm demeanor keeps the conversation grounded.
